rickyworld-rigmeshy-by-ricky-meshy-pose-.description: Guidance for shooting/posing a character photo before turning it into a rigged, animation-ready 3D model with Meshy AI's Auto-Rig — covers the ideal T-pose/A-pose reference shot, the full Image/Text-to-3D to Auto-Rig workflow, a troubleshooting table for common rigging failures (collapsing shoulders, fused fingers, asymmetric deformation, floating/sinking models), and UniRig as a free self-hosted alternative. Use this whenever the user wants to rig a character in Meshy, is preparing a reference photo for a humanoid/creature 3D model, mentions T-pose, A-pose, Meshy Auto-Rig, Mixamo-compatible…
